description:
A utility-scale solar developer is conducting a module technology selection study for a 50 MW (DC) ground-mounted PV project in Daggett, California (lat=34.867, lon=-116.783). Three candidate module technologies must be evaluated to determine which delivers the lowest LCOE and best 25-year financial performance at this high-DNI desert site.

Site and system parameters:
- Location: Daggett, CA — use the bundled Daggett weather file in SAM's solar resource library
- DC system size: 50,000 kW (50 MW DC), single-axis tracking, ground coverage ratio 0.4
- Inverter efficiency: 98%, DC losses: ~8% total (wiring, mismatch, soiling, shading)

Three module technologies:
  Tech A - Standard mono-Si: module efficiency 20.4%, Pmp=440W, Vmp=41.1V, Imp=10.7A, Voc=49.5V, Isc=11.4A, temp coeff Pmp=-0.36%/C, installed price $1.05/W DC
  Tech B - Premium HJT (heterojunction): efficiency 22.8%, Pmp=490W, Vmp=43.5V, Imp=11.3A, Voc=52.2V, Isc=12.0A, temp coeff Pmp=-0.26%/C, installed price $1.20/W DC
  Tech C - CdTe thin film: efficiency 19.1%, Pmp=440W, Vmp=88.0V, Imp=5.0A, Voc=108V, Isc=5.4A, temp coeff Pmp=-0.28%/C, installed price $0.95/W DC

Financial assumptions (same for all):
- BOS: $0.45/W DC, inverter: $0.06/W DC, EPC overhead: 10% of equipment
- O&M: $14/kW-yr, degradation: 0.5%/yr
- Analysis period: 25 years, discount rate: 6.0%, federal ITC: 30%
- Debt fraction: 60%, loan rate: 5.5%, term: 18 years
- PPA price: $35/MWh

A bankability-grade analysis requires modeling each technology's individual electrical parameters — efficiency, temperature coefficients, and cell-level I-V characteristics — not just a simplified efficiency factor. Use SAM's physics-based PV model that accepts per-module electrical parameters.

For each technology, calculate: Year 1 annual energy (MWh), capacity factor (%), total installed cost ($), real LCOE ($/MWh), 25-year NPV ($), and 25-year IRR (%). Identify the technology with the lowest LCOE.

Save results to: /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/Daggett_Module_Technology_LCOE.json

The JSON must contain a 'configurations' array (3 entries, each with: tech_name, module_efficiency_pct, module_price_per_w, total_installed_cost_usd, annual_energy_year1_mwh, capacity_factor_pct, lcoe_real_usd_per_mwh, npv_25yr_usd, irr_pct), an 'optimal_technology' field, a 'site' field ('Daggett, CA'), and a 'study_summary' field.
